title_ja: データ・AI・実験ワークフロー基盤
title_en: Data, AI, and experimental workflow platform
summary_ja: HPC、AI、データ転送、実験施設をまたぐ実行と再開可能性を扱う暫定ロードマップです。個別ツールの機能とHPCI横断サービスを区別します。
summary_en: A provisional roadmap for execution and restartability across HPC, AI, data transfer, and experimental facilities. It separates individual tool capabilities from HPCI-wide services.

tracks.name_ja: 再開可能なワークフロー
tracks.summary_ja: 依存関係、再実行、監視、実行先を追跡します。
tracks.summary_en: Track dependencies, restart, monitoring, and execution backends.
tracks.current_state_ja: Parsl、Nextflow、WHEEL等に個別機能がありますが、共通運用は未確認です。 今回の限定的な追補：Pegasus5.1.3のSFAPI adapterはcredential・scope・runtime前提を残し、adaptive retryは失敗後にのみ作用し、rescue DAGはpartial job状態を復元しない。Parsl同一run cacheは例外も再利用するがcheckpointは保存せず、同時uncached呼出しは重複実行し得る。RO-Crate0.6の版組合せ・IRI変更をOPS-012と共通化し、任意status/resource記録・欠落status成功解釈を全試行監査と混同しない。施設認可・budget・失敗取消cache retryを既存workflow gateへ加える。 Workflow Run RO-Crate0.6（9月7日）はRO-Crate1.3/Workflow1.1へ整合し、旧0.1–0.5の1.1/1.0とIRIが異なる。旧0.5確認は履歴で、適合は全失敗・取消・cache・retry試行の完全性やlossless再実行を保証しない。不老・弐の大学報告による10月1日9時開始と希望home staging・利用者copy責任を反映し、3MIG queue復旧・ACL/checksum受入は未確認。Roihu文書のidentity assurance・24時間SSH certificate・CPU/GPU再build条件は実移行実績ではなく、Allas無制限容量も仮定しない。 理研とソフトバンクは第3期公募で20件の提案を採択しました。採択機関には覚書の締結後、黎明、ibm_kobe、富岳、ROQUOの利用アカウントを付与する予定です。次回公募と一部成果の大規模実験支援は2027年度の早期を予定します。採択は量子優位性や性能向上を実証した結果ではありません。 Fujitsuはニューメキシコ州と量子計算研究センターの設立に向けた連携を発表しました。量子計算、量子シミュレーション、AI、古典HPCを組み合わせる研究でMONAKAの役割も検討します。センターの開設日、導入構成、性能結果は示されておらず、稼働済み施設とは扱いません。
tracks.current_state_en: Parsl, Nextflow, WHEEL, and others provide individual capabilities; common operations remain unverified. Scoped additions in this batch: Pegasus 5.1.3 SFAPI adapters retain credential/scope/runtime prerequisites; adaptive retry acts after failures and rescue DAGs do not restore partial-job state. Parsl within-run cache can reuse exceptions while checkpoints omit them; simultaneous uncached calls may duplicate execution. Share RO-Crate 0.6 version/IRI interpretation with OPS-012: optional status/resources and omitted-status success defaults do not assure all-attempt auditing. Extend the existing workflow gate with facility authorization, budgets and failed/cancelled/cached/retry attempts. Workflow Run RO-Crate 0.6 (September 7) aligns with RO-Crate 1.3/Workflow 1.1 and changes IRIs from legacy 0.1–0.5 at 1.1/1.0. Keep historical 0.5; conformance does not assure all failed/cancelled/cached/retry attempts or lossless replay. Reflect Nagoya-reported October 1 09:00 start, requested-home staging and user copy responsibilities without MIG recovery/ACL/checksum acceptance. Roihu identity assurance, 24-hour SSH certificates and CPU/GPU rebuild requirements are documented prerequisites, not migration results or unlimited Allas capacity. RIKEN and SoftBank selected 20 proposals. Accounts for Reimei, ibm_kobe, Fugaku and ROQUO are planned after memoranda are signed. The next call and support for selected large-scale experiments are planned early in FY2027. Selection does not establish quantum advantage or measured speedup. Fujitsu announced collaboration with New Mexico toward establishing a quantum computing research center. It will examine MONAKA's role in research combining quantum computing, simulation, AI and classical HPC. Opening dates, installed configurations and performance results were not provided; this is not an operational-center announcement.
tracks.hpci_implications_ja: 代表ワークフローを複数センターで同じ来歴付きで再実行する必要があります。 著者preprintはNVダイヤモンド実測とTSUBAME4検証を結合した事例を報告。予測一致でもドリフトした取得を不確定とし、基準を緩めず修正した。Sageのsimulation/replayとは別の限定的な物理workflow例。装置構築・安全上限設定は人が担当。最終予測固定は取得後・target解析前であり、実測dataは要請提供、研究promptは非公開。 10月28日のdraftレビューは、保留中の遅延変換報告へ分布上の差を追加する。変換後の下限clampは下限への確率集中を生み、棄却再標本化と同じ分布ではない。既定値と負荷モデルの根拠は未合意で、採択済み修正・修正版releaseではない。 SDK0.4.11はSSE cursor・chunk保持とwait/join/cancel再接続のbackoffを収録。空ID・分割event・応答切断を試験する案。PR9481は5回上限と初回失敗時raiseを維持。Store認可とは別で、exactly-onceや施設受入を保証しない。 Nextflow 26.10.4はPR7887を収録。型付き関数のrecord戻り値が実体依存でhash化され、resumeでcache hitしない問題を修正する。record戻り型の消去による具体的なcache再開修正であり、既存のログ秘匿化とは別。戻り値の実行時型検査への影響は確認事項として残す。
tracks.hpci_implications_en: Representative workflows need reproducible execution with provenance across centers. An author preprint reports an NV-diamond physical investigation coupled to TSUBAME4 computational checks. Agents rejected a drifting acquisition despite predictive agreement and revised it without loosening criteria. This adds a bounded physical-workflow example beyond Sage simulations/replays. Humans built the apparatus and configured safety limits; final predictions were locked after acquisition but before target analysis. Raw data require request and study prompts are omitted. The October28 draft review adds a distribution-level tradeoff to the pending delay-transform report: enforcing a post-scaling floor by clamping creates mass at the floor rather than preserving rejection-sampling semantics. The proposed default and workload rationale remain unresolved; this is neither accepted remediation nor a released fix. SDK 0.4.11 ships SSE cursor/chunk preservation and bounded backoff for wait/join/cancel reconnects. Qualify empty IDs, split events and interrupted responses; PR9481 retains five attempts and first-request failures still raise. This is separate from Store authorization; no exactly-once guarantee or site acceptance. Nextflow 26.10.4 includes PR7887: typed-function record results previously received identity-dependent task hashes, preventing cache hits on resume. The correction erases record return types. This is a concrete cache-recovery fix, separate from pending log redaction. Runtime checking of record return values remains a qualification concern.

tracks.name_ja: 転送・ストリーミング・来歴
tracks.summary_ja: 大容量転送と実験データの連続処理を扱います。
tracks.summary_en: Cover bulk transfer and continuous experimental-data processing.
tracks.current_state_ja: ADIOS2、Globus、EuroHPC workflow資料を確認しました。
tracks.current_state_en: ADIOS2, Globus, and EuroHPC workflow documentation were checked.
tracks.hpci_implications_ja: 認証、データ所在、再送、メタデータ、保存期間を一体で試験します。 Personal3.3.2の新規・再setupと既存collectionを区別し、共有RAG indexはgraph build5時間34分と全工程25時間、品質・入力・復旧条件を分けて比較する評価案。現地修正・独立再現・SLA達成ではない。 著者preprintはNVダイヤモンド実測とTSUBAME4検証を結合した事例を報告。予測一致でもドリフトした取得を不確定とし、基準を緩めず修正した。Sageのsimulation/replayとは別の限定的な物理workflow例。装置構築・安全上限設定は人が担当。最終予測固定は取得後・target解析前であり、実測dataは要請提供、研究promptは非公開。 共同実証は神戸・柏間800Gbps APNで、第2世代HPCI共用ストレージ検証環境とMMCFTP/NVMeサーバを併用。合算転送は最大約775Gbps、750Gbps超を数分継続し、この構成のAPN遅延はSINET比約20%低減と報告。取得から判断までの期限や第3世代の本番SLAを確立する値ではない。 GCS 5.4.100はgaccess.ioへのdomain移行を追加。変更履歴は5.4.99のsupport終了を2027年4月28日と明記し、前回未確定だった後続版依存の期限を具体化した。参照先移行guideは2025年7月16日更新のまま将来toolを記載する。 Ceph21.2.0はUmbrella初のstable版。containerのhostはx86-64-v3、cephadmはPython3.9以上を要求。CephFSのmirror checkpoint/status、RGWのGlacier/tape復元状態の永続化を記載し、object重複排除はtechnology previewとする。 DDNはUNSWがEXAScalerとArcitecta Mediafluxを選び、11保存systemを置換する計画を発表。学内cacheと学外storageを連携し、connectorでfilesystem metadata変更を取得する設計。2027年初納入・同年後半稼働は予定。 Nextflow 26.10.4はPR7887を収録。型付き関数のrecord戻り値が実体依存でhash化され、resumeでcache hitしない問題を修正する。record戻り型の消去による具体的なcache再開修正であり、既存のログ秘匿化とは別。戻り値の実行時型検査への影響は確認事項として残す。
tracks.hpci_implications_en: Test identity, location, retransmission, metadata, and retention together. Proposed checks distinguish Personal 3.3.2 new/repeated setup from existing collections;for shared RAG, separate 5h 34m graph build from 25h end-to-end with quality, input and recovery conditions. This is not site remediation, independent reproduction or achieved SLA. An author preprint reports an NV-diamond physical investigation coupled to TSUBAME4 computational checks. Agents rejected a drifting acquisition despite predictive agreement and revised it without loosening criteria. This adds a bounded physical-workflow example beyond Sage simulations/replays. Humans built the apparatus and configured safety limits; final predictions were locked after acquisition but before target analysis. Raw data require request and study prompts are omitted. A joint study reports Kobe–Kashiwa transfer on an800Gbps APN path using second-generation HPCI storage validation infrastructure plus MMCFTP/NVMe servers. Combined traffic peaked near775Gbps and exceeded750Gbps for several minutes. APN latency was about20% below SINET in this setup. These are bounded transfer results, with neither instrument-to-decision latency nor a third-generation storage service SLA established. GCS 5.4.100 adds gaccess.io domain migration. The changelog now gives 5.4.99 a support end of April28,2027, resolving the successor-dependent deadline left unknown in the prior review. The linked migration guide remains dated July16,2025 and still describes future tooling. Ceph21.2.0 is the first stable Umbrella release. Container hosts require x86-64-v3 and cephadm requires Python3.9+. Release notes add CephFS mirroring checkpoints/status and RGW persistent Glacier/tape restore state; object dedup remains technology preview. DDN announces UNSW selection of EXAScaler with Arcitecta Mediaflux to replace11 storage systems. The planned design links campus caches to off-campus storage and captures filesystem metadata changes through a connector. Delivery is planned early2027; go-live later2027 remains expected. Nextflow 26.10.4 includes PR7887: typed-function record results previously received identity-dependent task hashes, preventing cache hits on resume. The correction erases record return types. This is a concrete cache-recovery fix, separate from pending log redaction. Runtime checking of record return values remains a qualification concern.

milestones.detail_ja: 共通認証、データ転送、再開、SLAを含む提供時期は確認できません。
milestones.detail_en: No public date establishes a service combining common identity, transfer, restart, and SLA.

A provisional plan to test reproducibility for at least one simulation, AI, and experimental-data workflow. Data-path acceptance should check DTN configuration-key restoration, interrupted-transfer restart, checksums, permissions and destination logical capacity. Globus multi-DTN operation and HPCI cross-site replicas alone do not guarantee a common SLA, recovery time or deleted-file restoration. This existing Q2 gate does not change service-specific evacuation start dates or migration deadlines. Proposed acceptance criteria include preventing replay of irreversible experiments, joining successful-result lineage to failed attempts, queued-authorization revocation and worker isolation, and Slurm/Kubernetes resource and queue-time differences. Q2 2027 remains the existing OpenFS provisional plan, not a project delivery commitment. Additional criteria: pin contexts/expanded IRIs for RO-Crate 0.6/1.3/Workflow 1.1 and legacy 0.1–0.5/1.1/1.0 and test old/new import/export. Optional status/resources do not certify all failed/cancelled/cached/retry attempts. Check facility-adapter authorization/budgets, scientific-input generation/requalification and input age/history/fallback. Schema conformance is not scientific reproduction or lossless replay.
milestones.label_ja: 代表ワークフロー実証の暫定判断点
milestones.detail_ja: シミュレーション、AI、実験データの少なくとも各1件で再実行性を確認する暫定計画です。 データ経路の評価条件として、DTN設定鍵の復元、転送中断後の再開、checksum、アクセス権、転送先論理容量を確認する。Globusの複数DTNやHPCIの拠点間複製だけで、共通SLA・復旧時間・削除復元を保証しない。既存Q2判断点は個別サービスの退避開始日や移行期限を変更しない。 提案する受入条件は、不可逆な実験操作の再実行禁止、成功来歴と失敗試行の連結、queue権限失効とworker隔離、Slurm/Kubernetesの資源・待ち時間契約の差を含める。2027年Q2は既存のOpenFS暫定計画であり、プロジェクトの提供約束ではない。 追補条件：RO-Crate0.6/1.3/Workflow1.1と旧0.1–0.5/1.1/1.0のcontext・expanded IRIを固定して旧新import/exportを試験する。status/resource省略許容は全failed/cancelled/cached/retry試行の監査を保証しない。facility adapter認可・budget、科学入力の世代変更・再適合、入力age/history/fallbackを確認し、schema適合を科学再現やlossless replayとしない。

caveat_ja: 単一のAIモデル・単一エージェントによる暫定調査です。独立したAIモデルによるConsensus Gateは未完了です。公表資料の確認時点、公開目標、OpenFSの暫定計画を区別し、未公表の時期・費用・性能は推測していません。
caveat_en: Provisional research by one model and one agent; Consensus review by independent models is incomplete. Documentation checks, published targets, and provisional OpenFS plans are separated, and unpublished timing, cost, and performance are not inferred.
